Both lowest shoe contact points sit on the same invisible horizontal baseline at y=847 (90% canvas height); no visible floor, line or shadow.
Character height about 800px (85% canvas height), top of ears about y=47, foot soles y=847. Whole figure and both floating discs centered in the canvas with generous empty margins. Do not crop anything.

Bare hands. No costume changes.
Clean decisive outlines and simplified main internal lines suitable for later fluorescent LINE ART conversion: clear silhouette, clear microphone at mouth, separated fingers, readable shoes/limbs, no excessive texture/hatching or tiny glossy details. Match the existing MV's warm subdued anime rendering. Fully clothed, neutral eye-level staging. No text, letters on shoes, logos, watermarks, red thread, chair, scenery, ground or motion marks. Transparent PNG.
